description: MySQL 8.0 server configuration rendered to /etc/mysql/my.cnf ([mysqld] section).

fields.name: innodb_buffer_pool_size
fields.description: InnoDB buffer pool; the single most important memory setting. Upstream default 128M.
fields.title: Buffer pool size

fields.name: innodb_buffer_pool_instances
fields.description: Number of buffer pool regions; only meaningful when the pool is larger than 1G.
fields.title: Buffer pool instances

fields.name: innodb_redo_log_capacity
fields.description: Total redo log size. Replaces the deprecated innodb_log_file_size/innodb_log_files_in_group.
fields.title: Redo log capacity

fields.name: innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit
fields.description: 1 = ACID (flush+fsync on commit), 2 = flush on commit and fsync once a second, 0 = neither.
fields.title: Flush log at commit

fields.name: innodb_flush_method
fields.description: Data/log flush method. Upstream default is fsync; stroppy defaults to O_DIRECT so the OS page cache does not double-buffer the pool during a benchmark.
fields.title: Flush method

fields.name: innodb_io_capacity
fields.description: Background page-flush budget in IOPS. Upstream default 200 for 8.0.
fields.title: I/O capacity

fields.name: innodb_io_capacity_max
fields.description: Upper flush budget when InnoDB has to catch up; must be >= innodb_io_capacity.
fields.title: I/O capacity max

fields.name: innodb_read_io_threads
fields.description: Background read threads.
fields.title: Read I/O threads

fields.name: innodb_write_io_threads
fields.description: Background write threads.
fields.title: Write I/O threads

fields.name: innodb_thread_concurrency
fields.description: Cap on threads inside InnoDB; 0 = unlimited (the default).
fields.title: Thread concurrency

fields.name: innodb_lock_wait_timeout
fields.description: How long a transaction waits for a row lock before it is rolled back.
fields.title: Lock wait timeout

fields.name: innodb_doublewrite
fields.description: Torn-page protection. OFF trades crash safety for write throughput.
fields.title: Doublewrite buffer

fields.name: innodb_file_per_table
fields.description: Store each table in its own .ibd tablespace.
fields.title: File per table

fields.name: innodb_dedicated_server
fields.description: Let InnoDB size the buffer pool and redo log from the machine's RAM, ignoring the values above.
fields.title: Dedicated server

fields.name: log_bin
fields.description: Base name of the binary log files; binary logging is on by default since 8.0.
fields.title: Binary log base name

fields.name: binlog_format
fields.description: Row-based logging is the default and the only format group replication accepts.
fields.title: Binlog format

fields.name: binlog_row_image
fields.description: How much of each row goes into the binary log.
fields.title: Binlog row image

fields.name: sync_binlog
fields.description: fsync the binary log every N commit groups; 1 is the durable default, 0 leaves it to the OS.
fields.title: Sync binlog

fields.name: binlog_expire_logs_seconds
fields.description: Binary log purge age; 0 disables automatic purging. Upstream default 30 days.
fields.title: Binlog retention

fields.name: gtid_mode
fields.description: GTID-based replication. Group replication requires ON.
fields.title: GTID mode

fields.name: enforce_gtid_consistency
fields.description: Reject statements that cannot be logged transactionally; ON is required with gtid_mode=ON.
fields.title: Enforce GTID consistency

fields.name: log_replica_updates
fields.description: Write replicated changes to this server's own binary log — required for chained replication and for group replication.
fields.title: Log replica updates

fields.name: rpl_semi_sync_source_enabled
fields.description: Semisynchronous source side; loads semisync_source.so via plugin_load_add.
fields.title: Semisync source

fields.name: rpl_semi_sync_source_timeout
fields.description: How long the source waits for a replica ack before falling back to async.
fields.title: Semisync timeout

fields.name: rpl_semi_sync_replica_enabled
fields.description: Semisynchronous replica side; loads semisync_replica.so via plugin_load_add.
fields.title: Semisync replica

fields.name: replica_parallel_workers
fields.description: Parallel applier threads on the replica; 0 = single-threaded.
fields.title: Applier workers

fields.name: replica_preserve_commit_order
fields.description: Commit in source order when applying in parallel.
fields.title: Preserve commit order

fields.name: read_only
fields.description: Reject writes from clients without CONNECTION_ADMIN — set on replicas.
fields.title: Read only

fields.name: super_read_only
fields.description: Reject writes from every account, administrators included; implies read_only.
fields.title: Super read only

fields.name: group_replication
fields.description: Enable the group replication plugin; renders the whole group_replication_* block.
fields.title: Group replication

fields.name: group_replication_group_name
fields.description: UUID naming the group; identical on every member.
fields.title: Group name

fields.name: group_replication_start_on_boot
fields.description: Join the group automatically at server start.
fields.title: Start on boot

fields.name: group_replication_bootstrap_group
fields.description: Create the group instead of joining it — exactly one member, exactly once.
fields.title: Bootstrap group

fields.name: group_replication_single_primary_mode
fields.description: One writable primary (ON) or multi-primary (OFF).
fields.title: Single primary mode

fields.name: group_replication_enforce_update_everywhere_checks
fields.description: Multi-primary safety checks; must be OFF in single-primary mode.
fields.title: Update-everywhere checks

fields.name: group_replication_consistency
fields.description: Group synchronization before or after transactions. BEFORE waits for preceding transactions before reads, allowing read-after-write through replicas; this is separate from SQL transaction isolation.
fields.title: Transaction consistency

fields.name: bind_address
fields.description: Addresses mysqld listens on; * or 0.0.0.0 for all IPv4.
fields.title: Bind address

fields.name: port
fields.description: TCP port for the classic MySQL protocol.
fields.title: Port

fields.name: max_connections
fields.description: Maximum simultaneous client connections.
fields.title: Max connections

fields.name: max_connect_errors
fields.description: Interrupted handshakes from one host before it is blocked.
fields.title: Max connect errors

fields.name: thread_cache_size
fields.description: Threads kept for reuse after a client disconnects.
fields.title: Thread cache size

fields.name: wait_timeout
fields.description: Idle seconds before a non-interactive connection is closed.
fields.title: Wait timeout

fields.name: interactive_timeout
fields.description: Idle seconds before an interactive connection is closed.
fields.title: Interactive timeout

fields.name: max_allowed_packet
fields.description: Largest single packet or generated string.
fields.title: Max allowed packet

fields.name: table_open_cache
fields.description: Open table handles cached across all sessions.
fields.title: Table open cache

fields.name: table_definition_cache
fields.description: Cached table definitions.
fields.title: Table definition cache

fields.name: tmp_table_size
fields.description: Largest in-memory internal temporary table before it spills to disk.
fields.title: Temp table size

fields.name: max_heap_table_size
fields.description: Largest user-created MEMORY table; caps tmp_table_size too.
fields.title: Max heap table size

fields.name: open_files_limit
fields.description: File descriptors mysqld asks the OS for.
fields.title: Open files limit

fields.name: sql_mode
fields.description: Comma-separated SQL modes; the value below is the 8.0/8.4 upstream default.
fields.title: SQL mode

fields.name: character_set_server
fields.description: Default character set of the server.
fields.title: Server character set

fields.name: collation_server
fields.description: Default collation; must belong to character_set_server.
fields.title: Server collation

fields.name: default_time_zone
fields.description: Server time zone; a fixed offset keeps benchmark timestamps reproducible.
fields.title: Default time zone

fields.name: lower_case_table_names
fields.description: 0 = case-sensitive names as stored, 1 = lowercased, 2 = stored as given, compared lowercase. Fixed at initialization.
fields.title: Lower case table names

fields.name: transaction_isolation
fields.description: Default isolation level for new sessions.
fields.title: Transaction isolation

fields.name: performance_schema
fields.description: Instrumentation engine; needed by mysqld_exporter's perf_schema collectors.
fields.title: Performance schema

fields.name: performance_schema_max_digest_length
fields.description: Bytes kept per normalized statement digest.
fields.title: Max digest length

fields.name: general_log
fields.description: Log every statement — very expensive, off during load tests.
fields.title: General log

fields.name: slow_query_log
fields.description: Log statements slower than long_query_time.
fields.title: Slow query log

fields.name: long_query_time
fields.description: Slow-query threshold; fractional seconds are allowed.
fields.title: Long query time

fields.name: log_slow_extra
fields.description: Add per-statement counters to slow-log records.
fields.title: Slow log extra fields

fields.name: log_error_verbosity
fields.description: 1 = errors, 2 = errors and warnings, 3 = adds notes.
fields.title: Error log verbosity

fields.name: replica_parallel_type
fields.description: How the applier partitions work. Removed in 8.4, where LOGICAL_CLOCK is always used.
fields.title: Applier parallel type

fields.name: transaction_write_set_extraction
fields.description: Write-set hashing algorithm; XXHASH64 is required by group replication. Removed in 8.4, where write sets are always extracted.
fields.title: Write set extraction

fields.name: binlog_transaction_dependency_tracking
fields.description: Source of the parallelization info written into the binary log. Removed in 8.4, where WRITESET is always used.
fields.title: Dependency tracking

fields.name: default_authentication_plugin
fields.description: Authentication plugin for new accounts. Removed in 8.4 — use authentication_policy there.
fields.title: Default auth plugin

fields.name: server_id
fields.description: Unique replication id; filled by the server from topology.
fields.title: Server id

fields.name: report_host
fields.description: Address this member reports to the source/group; filled by the server from topology.
fields.title: Report host

fields.name: group_replication_local_address
fields.description: host:port of this member's group communication endpoint; filled by the server from topology.
fields.title: GR local address

fields.name: group_replication_group_seeds
fields.description: Comma-separated seed endpoints of the group; filled by the server from topology.
fields.title: GR group seeds

fields.name: custom
fields.description: Raw `key = value` settings appended verbatim at the end of the file; keys must match ^[a-z_][a-z0-9_.]*$. Entry order is not preserved.
fields.title: Extra settings

fields.name: cluster_lines
fields.description: Rendered topology lines (server_id, report_host).

computed.expr:
(("server_id" in root) ? "server_id" + " = " + string(root["server_id"]) + "\n" : "") +
(("report_host" in root) ? "report_host" + " = " + string(root["report_host"]) + "\n" : "")

fields.title: Cluster lines

fields.name: semisync_lines
fields.description: plugin_load_add and rpl_semi_sync_* lines, emitted only when semisync is on.

computed.expr:
((("rpl_semi_sync_source_enabled" in root) && root.rpl_semi_sync_source_enabled == "ON") ?
			"plugin_load_add = semisync_source.so
loose-rpl_semi_sync_source_enabled = ON
" +(("rpl_semi_sync_source_timeout" in root) ? "loose-rpl_semi_sync_source_timeout" + " = " + string(root["rpl_semi_sync_source_timeout"]) + "
" : "") : "") +
((("rpl_semi_sync_replica_enabled" in root) && root.rpl_semi_sync_replica_enabled == "ON") ?
			"plugin_load_add = semisync_replica.so
loose-rpl_semi_sync_replica_enabled = ON
" : "")

fields.title: Semisync lines

fields.name: group_replication_lines
fields.description: The whole group_replication_* block, emitted only when group replication is on.

computed.expr:
((("group_replication" in root) && root.group_replication) ? ("plugin_load_add = group_replication.so
" +
(("group_replication_group_name" in root) ? "loose-group_replication_group_name" + " = " + string(root["group_replication_group_name"]) + "
" : "") +
(("group_replication_start_on_boot" in root) ? "loose-group_replication_start_on_boot" + " = " + string(root["group_replication_start_on_boot"]) + "
" : "") +
(("group_replication_bootstrap_group" in root) ? "loose-group_replication_bootstrap_group" + " = " + string(root["group_replication_bootstrap_group"]) + "
" : "") +
(("group_replication_single_primary_mode" in root) ? "loose-group_replication_single_primary_mode" + " = " + string(root["group_replication_single_primary_mode"]) + "
" : "") +
(("group_replication_enforce_update_everywhere_checks" in root) ? "loose-group_replication_enforce_update_everywhere_checks" + " = " + string(root["group_replication_enforce_update_everywhere_checks"]) + "
" : "") +
(("group_replication_local_address" in root) ? "loose-group_replication_local_address" + " = " + string(root["group_replication_local_address"]) + "
" : "") +
(("group_replication_group_seeds" in root) ? "loose-group_replication_group_seeds" + " = " + string(root["group_replication_group_seeds"]) + "
" : "") +
(("group_replication_consistency" in root) ? "loose-group_replication_consistency" + " = " + string(root["group_replication_consistency"]) + "
" : "") +
(("transaction_write_set_extraction" in root) ? "transaction_write_set_extraction" + " = " + string(root["transaction_write_set_extraction"]) + "
" : "") +
(("binlog_transaction_dependency_tracking" in root) ? "binlog_transaction_dependency_tracking" + " = " + string(root["binlog_transaction_dependency_tracking"]) + "
" : "")) : "")

fields.title: Group replication lines

fields.name: custom_rendered
fields.description: The `custom` map joined into config lines; the template prints it at the end of the file.
fields.title: Rendered extra settings

rules.expr: !("innodb_io_capacity" in root) || !("innodb_io_capacity_max" in root) || int(root.innodb_io_capacity_max) >= int(root.innodb_io_capacity)

rules.message: enforce_update_everywhere_checks must be OFF in single-primary mode

rules.expr: !("super_read_only" in root) || root.super_read_only == "OFF" || (("read_only" in root) && root.read_only == "ON")
!("max_heap_table_size" in root) || !("tmp_table_size" in root) || int(root.max_heap_table_size) >= int(root.tmp_table_size)

rules.message: group_replication_group_name is required when: ("group_replication" in root) && root.group_replication
